**65th Annual Grammy Awards (2023) – Five headline categories & their winners**

| # | Category | Winning entry | Artist(s) / Performer(s) | Songwriters / Producers (where applicable) |
|---|----------|---------------|--------------------------|--------------------------------------------|
| 1 | **Record of the Year** | “**About Damn Time**” | **Lizzo** (lead vocalist) | Produced by *Ricky Reed* (real name Eric Frederic) and *Lizzo*; engineered & mixed by *Mark “Spike” Stent* and team. |
| 2 | **Album of the Year** | “**Harry’s House**” | **Harry Styles** | Produced by *Kid Harpoon* (Tom Hull) and *Ty de Luna* (Ty de Luna, also known as *Ty de Luna).* Executive production and engineering credits include *Manny Marroquin*, *John Hill*, and *Ricky Reed* among others. |
| 3 | **Song of the Year** | “**Just Like That**” | **Bonnie Raitt** (performer) | Written by **Bonnie Raitt** and **Allen Toussaint**. |
| 4 | **Best New Artist** | **Samara Joy** | (Jazz vocalist) | No single song/album is attached to the award; the accolade recognizes Samara Joy’s breakout impact across her debut album **“Linger Awhile”** and related releases. |
| 5 | **Best Pop Duo/Group Performance** | “**Unholy**” | **Sam Smith & Kim Petras** | Written by *James Baker*, *Ian Healy*, *Sam Smith* and *Kim Petras*; produced by *Tom Auden* and *Ian Healy*. |

### Quick notes

* The **four “General Field”** categories (Record, Album, Song, Best New Artist) are the awards most often highlighted as the ceremony’s “big” prizes.  
* I added **Best Pop Duo/Group Performance** as the fifth high‑profile category because it is the only other “pop‑centric” award that consistently appears in media round‑ups of the night’s top honors.  
* All winners were announced during the televised ceremony on **5 February 2023** at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles.  

If you meant a different set of five categories (e.g., including a genre‑specific award such as *Best Pop Vocal Album*), just let me know and I can swap it in!
